accueil.titreOnglet: Habitum — the habit tracker that never asks for an account
accueil.description: Habits, tasks, goals and focus time. Your data stays on your device: no account, no trackers, no subscription. Free and open source.
accueil.titre: Your habits stay on your device.
accueil.chapeau: Eleven views, a calculation engine checked against 62 reference values, and nothing that leaves. No account to create, no server to run, no subscription to cancel.
accueil.chiffre1Legende: To use, and to run. Not one paid component is required.
accueil.chiffre2Legende: Reference values for the calculation engine, re-checked on every release. One mismatch stops the release.
accueil.chiffre3Legende: Views, in French and English, across three themes.
accueil.argTexte1: Everything is written to your browser’s local storage. No server receives your data, because there is no server at all: the page is static. That is not a promise, it is a consequence of the architecture — and you can check it in thirty seconds.
accueil.argTitre2: Seven ways to measure a habit
accueil.argTexte2: Yes/no, quantity, duration, multi-day total, subtask list, a ceiling not to exceed, an exact value. Current streak, record, success rate over 7, 30, 90 or 365 days, six-month heatmap — all computed from your real log.
accueil.argTexte3: Pomodoro, stopwatch, countdown, intervals. A finished session can credit the habit it targeted. An account with no session shows zero minutes — never an estimate, never a decorative figure.
accueil.modeleTexte: Most habit apps can tick a box and count a quantity. Habitum has seven habit types and three goal types, and they change what you can actually track: “fewer than three coffees” does not fit in a checkbox.
accueil.modeleLegendeH: The seven habit types and their success rule.
accueil.hCheckM: The thing was done, or it wasn’t.
accueil.hCountM: A number: glasses of water, pages read, repetitions.
accueil.hCountR: The day’s value reaches the target.
accueil.hTimeM: Minutes, entered by hand or credited by the timer.
accueil.hTimeR: The day’s duration reaches the target.
accueil.hTotalM: A total that runs across days, with no daily reset.
accueil.hTotalR: The running total reaches the target.
accueil.hListM: A list of subtasks, ticked one by one.
accueil.hLimitM: A value not to exceed: cigarettes, coffees, spending.
accueil.hLimitR: The logged value is less than or equal to the target — and never in advance: with no entry, the day is not a success.
accueil.hExactR: The day’s value is exactly the target.
accueil.modeleLegendeO: The three goal types, fed by your habits or entered by hand.
accueil.oCumulM: A total to reach before a deadline — 100 km this quarter, 24 books this year.
accueil.oMsM: A series of dated steps, cleared in order.
accueil.oReduceM: A starting value brought down towards a target.
accueil.reseauTitre: Open the network tab. It is empty.
accueil.reseauTexte: This is the only privacy claim you can check without taking our word for it. Open your browser’s developer tools, the “Network” tab, then use the app: tick something, create something, start a timer. Not one request goes out. The code is public, the site’s security policy forbids every third-party origin, and an automated test suite fails if a single request comes back.
accueil.installTexte: Habitum is an installable web app. From the browser, “Install” puts it on the system like a native app: icon, clean window, direct launch.
accueil.install1: Desktop, tablet, phone — the same app, the same local storage.
accueil.install2: In airplane mode, a view you have opened reloads and works. Nothing waits on a network.
accueil.install3: Your data does not follow the device: to move between devices you export a file and import it. That is explicit, and it is deliberate.
accueil.r1: In your browser’s local storage (IndexedDB), on this device. Nowhere else: no server exists to receive it.
accueil.r2: No. No sign-up, no password, no email address. The app opens and works.
accueil.r3: Nothing, and nothing is planned. The product rests on no paid component, so there is no bill to pass on.
accueil.q4: What happens if I clear my browser?
accueil.r4: You lose everything — that is the honest price of local storage. The app reminds you to export, and takes an automatic backup before every import and every reset.
accueil.q5: Can I use it on two devices?
accueil.r5: Yes, by exporting a file from one and importing it into the other. There is no automatic sync: it would require an account and a server, which is exactly what the product refuses.
accueil.r6: Entirely. Once a view has loaded, nothing waits on the network — and the app is built to be reloaded in airplane mode.
accueil.r7: Yes, under the MIT licence. The repository is public: you can read it, build it yourself and host it wherever you like.
accueil.r8: No personal data is collected, so no processing takes place. Rights of access, rectification and erasure have no object — and your data is yours to export and delete, without asking anyone.
accueil.afficheTitre: Open it. It starts on an empty account.
accueil.afficheTexte: Three welcome screens — language, theme, three suggested habits, none pre-ticked. A demo data set exists, it is one link away and it is flagged as such inside the app. We will not let you believe in a history you do not have.

fonctionnalites.description: The eleven views of Habitum in detail: habits, tasks, goals, calendar, statistics, timer, notes, profile and settings.
fonctionnalites.titre: Eleven views, and what each one computes
fonctionnalites.chapeau: Habitum is not a checkbox notebook with a dark theme. Here is what each view actually does, and where its numbers come from.
fonctionnalites.vDashR: The state of the day on one screen: progress, live streaks, next deadlines, focus minutes.
fonctionnalites.vTodayR: The one view that survives a busy weekday: scheduled habits, due tasks, reminders. Tick, postpone, skip.
fonctionnalites.vHabitsR: Create and track the seven types. Scheduling by weekday, every N days, X times a week or a month.
fonctionnalites.vTasksR: Lists, subtasks, priorities, due dates and recurrence — daily, weekly, monthly, every N days, with per-occurrence exceptions.
fonctionnalites.vGoalsR: Cumulative, milestones and reductions. A goal can be fed by a habit: it advances when the habit does, with no double entry.
fonctionnalites.vCalR: Day, week, month and agenda. Slots created by dragging, moved and resized, overlaps flagged.
fonctionnalites.vStatsR: Success rates over 7, 30, 90 and 365 days, streaks, records, six-month heatmap, totals by category.
fonctionnalites.vTimerR: Pomodoro, stopwatch, countdown, intervals. A session can credit a duration habit.
fonctionnalites.vNotesR: Free-form notes, attachable to a day. Nothing is sent anywhere, here as elsewhere.
fonctionnalites.vProfileR: Several profiles on the same device, each with its own data.
fonctionnalites.vSettingsR: Language, theme, reminders, sound, vibration, export, import, backup, reset, local error log.
fonctionnalites.horsTexte: There is no automatic sync, no account, no social sharing, no leaderboard, no server-pushed notification. These are not missing features: each one would require a server that receives your data, and that is precisely what the product refuses.
